This matter is taken up through Hybrid Arrangement  (Virtual/Physical Mode).
 2.
Mr. Achyutananda Pattanaik, learned counsel enters appearance on behalf of the Informant by filing a vakalatnama in Court today and the same be kept on record.

3. Heard learned counsel for both the parties and perused the records.
4.

The Petitioner is apprehending arrest for the alleged commission of offence under Sections 376/506 of the Indian Penal Code in GR Case No.1319 of 2024 of the Court of the learned J.M.F.C.,
Chandikhol Jajpur, arising out of Jenapur P.S. Case No.191 of 2024.
5. Considering the facts of the case, this Court is not inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the Petitioner.
